name: Example: Calculating a Minor in a NxN Matrix
problem:
What is the minor of $a_{13}$ in 
$[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 2 & 3 \\ 5 & 1 & 2 & 0 \\ 1 & 6 & 0 & -1 \\ -6 & 3 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}]$
worked_solution:
To get the minor of $a_{13}$, we remove the $1$st row and $3$rd column:

$$
[\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & 2 & ∗ \\ 5 & 1 & ∗ & 0 \\ 1 & 6 & ∗ & -1 \\ -6 & 3 & ∗ & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
|\begin{aligned}5 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 6 & -1 \\ -6 & 3 & 0\end{aligned}|
$$
